verdict.rationale: The only SDK-like evidence is the official Node.js adapter (Keycloak Node.js Connect) in the keycloak GitHub org, a first-party client library for securing apps. The Admin REST API docs and the kcadm.sh CLI are an API and a CLI, not SDKs, so they earn no credit. missing for 10: documented official SDKs across multiple languages, an official admin-API client library, SDK reference docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.
